text:
anya: Quick sync — kicking off an 'admin entropy' cleanup and cross-account KMS entitlement reconciliation. Goal: reduce high-risk admin principals by 30% and close ownerless KMS key gaps in 3 weeks. Volunteers?

devon: scope? org-wide or just prod accounts?

anya: Start with prod + shared infra accounts, then expand. Plan: 1) ownerless/admin role report 2) KMS key policy diff 3) recertification runway 4) automated removals for stale principals

katie: I can run ownerless-role query and push a report.

mike: I'll own KMS policy diffs + test harness for cross-account grants.

olivia: I'll coordinate communications and the recert execs. Need checklist.

anya: here's the SQL I used earlier (adjust for `roles_v2` schema):

```
-- ownerless admin roles
select r.role_id, r.name, r.last_active_at
from roles_v2 r
left join role_owners o on r.role_id = o.role_id
where o.owner_id is null and r.is_admin = true;
```

devon: nice. can we also surface when the role last had an allow action? CloudTrail join?

anya: yes — append last_allow_ts from `auth_events` join on role binding. sample CLI to export CloudTrail for last 90d:

```
aws cloudtrail lookup-events --lookup-attributes AttributeKey=ResourceName,AttributeValue=arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/ --start-time 2026-02-15 --end-time 2026-03-15
```

security-bot: Export complete: 142 candidate principals -> gs://redwood-security/admin-entropy/2113456789-candidates.csv :eyes:

arnav: I'll prototype an idempotent removal script that 1) disables binding 2) notifies owner 3) deletes after 7d if no appeal.

mike: question on KMS: do we treat cross-account grants with kms:Decrypt as high risk even if bound to a service account? we had an async convo about transient SA keys.

olivia: treat them as high risk unless there is a documented SAML/OIDC flow and least-priv evidence. we need a secondary review step.

devon: propose triage rubric:
- risk: high/med/low
- evidence: last used, owner contact, justification doc
- action: recertify / timebox / remove

katie: pushed a preliminary CSV to the thread: link: https://storage.redwood/company/security/admin-entropy/2113456789-preview.csv

anya: next steps: run full ownerless query by EOD tomorrow. Mike to provide KMS diff by Tue. Arnav to submit removal PRs to infra-automation repo. Olivia to draft comms + appeal flow. I'll schedule 30m on Friday for sync.

mike: added test plan to the ticket: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/SEC-4121

olivia: tagging legal @katie for appeal wording? @katie?

katie: fine with wording, send me the draft.

security-bot: automated risk scan found 6 keys with public cross-account grants older than 180d. See ticket SEC-4122.

anya: Thanks all — will post runbook and checklist after sync. :thumbsup:

sre-bot: Reminder: scheduled snapshot of KMS policies runs at 03:00 UTC daily.

devon: acked, will review snapshots for anomalies.

olivia: Assigned owners: devon (audit join), katie (ownerless export), mike (KMS diff), arnav (removal automation), anya (overall). Due: 2026-03-22.

anya: closing thread for now — reply in-thread if you want in the Friday sync.
